name: find_tool
description: Find candidate tools by name or purpose. tool_kind must be exactly one of: all, local, installed_mcp, mcp_available (default 'all').

inputs.name: query
inputs.description: Tool search query. Required for mcp_available searches.

inputs.name: tool_kind
inputs.description: Tool set to search. Must be exactly one of: 'all' (default), 'local', 'installed_mcp', 'mcp_available'. No other values accepted.

inputs.name: limit
inputs.description: Maximum number of matches to return (up to 200).

inputs.name: include_descriptions
inputs.description: Deprecated. Descriptions are always included in find_tool results.

metadata.planner_description: Find candidate tools by name or purpose. tool_kind must be exactly one of: all, local, installed_mcp, mcp_available.
